note: Public topology dataset. Facts are sourced from vendor/standards documentation; qualitative value-driver scores are S3 research framing, not vendor specifications.

topologies.label: NVIDIA · NVL72
topologies.headline: 单机架 72 GPU：Scale-up 从服务器内部升级为整柜级计算单元

layout.detail: 72 Rubin / Blackwell-family GPUs in one NVLink rack-scale domain (generation-dependent).

facts: NVLink Switch provides all-to-all GPU communication across the rack.
Vera Rubin NVL72 aggregate NVLink bandwidth: 260 TB/s.
Rubin GPU NVLink 6 bandwidth: 3.6 TB/s bidirectional per GPU.
implications: Rack becomes the basic compute unit, so power, liquid cooling and scale-up cabling are co-designed.
Inside-rack copper remains structurally important; optics is more dominant when scaling beyond the rack.

topologies.label: AMD · Helios 72
topologies.headline: 开放 72 GPU Rack：UALink + UEC + OCP 把开放标准推到整柜级

layout.detail: 72 MI455X GPUs in AMD Helios using UALink over Ethernet (UALoE).

facts: 2.9 EF FP4 / 1.4 EF FP8; 31 TB HBM4.
260 TB/s aggregate scale-up bandwidth and 43 TB/s scale-out bandwidth.
implications: Open standards can widen the addressable supplier pool for switching, connectors and optics.
The key research variable is whether open scale-up achieves strong real-world efficiency and adoption.

topologies.label: Huawei · Atlas 900 A3
topologies.headline: 384 NPU：从单 Rack 进入多柜超节点，交换柜与计算柜成为同一系统
facts: Maximum 384 NPUs interconnected to work as one computer.
D2D bidirectional bandwidth 784 GB/s; 48 TB on-chip memory unified addressing; 200 ns single-hop latency.
implications: Multi-cabinet scale-up increases the importance of switch fabrics, cabling and optical/electrical co-design.
Public specs validate the architecture; detailed per-NPU optics BOM should remain a separate research model.

topologies.label: NVIDIA · Rubin Ultra NVL576
topologies.headline: 8×72 GPU 跨 Rack：Scale-up 第一次明确把 direct optical connection 带入 NVLink 域

layout.detail: Eight 72-GPU MGX NVL racks; two-layer all-to-all NVLink topology.

facts: Eight 72-GPU racks form one 576-GPU NVLink domain.
Uses copper and direct optical connections across the domain.
implications: Cross-rack scale-up is a major structural step for optics: optics is no longer only a scale-out story.
Two-layer all-to-all architecture raises the value of switch fabric, reliability and topology-aware software.

topologies.label: UALink 1.0 · 规范上限
topologies.status: standard envelope, not a single product
topologies.headline: 1024 是协议可扩展上限，不是一个统一 BOM：不要把“1024方案”当成同一种机器

layout.detail: UALink 1.0 supports up to 1,024 accelerators; implementation topology is vendor-dependent.

facts: UALink 1.0 enables 200G per lane scale-up connectivity.
Maximum scale-up domain: 1,024 accelerators within an AI computing pod.
UALink uses memory-semantic load/store communication; exact system topology is implementation-specific.
implications: The investment opportunity depends on actual implementations: switch radix, cable reach, optics boundary and rack count.
A protocol limit must not be converted directly into an optics/BOM estimate.

topologies.label: Huawei · Atlas 950
topologies.headline: 160 柜、8192 NPU、柜间全光：超节点进入数据中心级系统工程

layout.detail: 128 compute cabinets + 32 interconnect cabinets; 160 cabinets total; inter-cabinet all-optical interconnect.

facts: 128 compute cabinets + 32 interconnect cabinets; about 1,000 m² footprint.
Inter-cabinet all-optical interconnect; 8 EF FP8 / 16 EF FP4; 16 PB/s aggregate interconnect bandwidth.
implications: At this scale, optics, switching, power, cooling, reliability and software become inseparable from compute economics.
The correct unit for research shifts from server BOM to cabinet / MW / useful-token economics.

roadmap.headline: 下一条边界：更大 NVLink 域 + CPO
roadmap.text: NVIDIA's July 2026 NVLink roadmap states support for scale-up domains up to 1,152 GPUs and connectivity through co-packaged optics.
